label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is TP: java.util.Random.nextInt() generates unpredictable-but-predictable values used for rememberMeKey (L111), which is stored in cookies/session attributes without cryptographic strength. Alert 2 (java/xss) is FP: Cookie name/value (L120-L125) derive entirely from server-side variables (cookieName from getClass().getName(), rememberMeKey from Random.nextInt()), not user input.
